entry.cost_basis: ScaleDown vendor list price, USD 0.05/M input tokens; output is free. Explicit vendor reference scaledown:classify-1 (vendor list price), with no base-model price. The frozen pricing module has no key for this API, so this row uses an explicit reference at that price. The scored cost includes the frozen scorer's usage fallback for four HTTP 504 rows: USD 0.04369407407407409 per 1,000 decisions on the common 1,485-item basis (0.67643x the USD 0.06459465517241379 cap); USD 0.082679 per 1,000 over all 1,500. Provider-reported usage alone gives USD 0.035613266 per 1,000 common items and USD 0.074679 over all items, excluding usage estimates for those failures. Cost kind mixed: four rows have estimated usage. Not a bill or quote.
entry.disclosure: STOCK PROMPT: the canonical question is sent unchanged in ScaleDown's native Jev-compatible format (POST /v1/scaledown, model classify-1). The vendor asked for prompt tuning with its SLM_Agent method first; that method was applied by us on 40 public dev items only (no vendor code executed), and no variant beat the run-to-run noise floor, so the stock prompt is the only measured configuration. 4 items ended in HTTP 504 (gateway timeout) and are scored wrong; no retry. Free trial tokens plus a USD 5 evaluator-paid credit covered the run.
